name: Edna Simpson
bio: a Representative from Illinois; born in Carrollton, Greene County, Ill., October 26, 1891; elected as a Republican to the Eighty-sixth Congress (January 3, 1959-January 3, 1961); did not seek renomination in 1960; died on May 15, 1984, in Carrollton, Ill.; interment at Carrollton City Cemetery, Carrollton, Ill.
